periods.summary: Mira is an energetic Quedolan representative who trains Ainalise's magic control by making her run over violently flowing water. During the briefing she reacts to Vermillion's roster and asks whether Ikki is truly as strong as rumored. When Or-Gaule forces John to kill Reed and Luke, Mira points her twin-gun Device at John but recognizes the need to flee. She tries to drag the grieving Ainalise away, only for Or-Gaule to make John use Circus Maximus, killing both women.

key_events.summary: Participates in team training and roster discussion.
Attempts to save Ainalise and dies in John's forced charge.
